findings.title: Named-pipe replacement can expose the hub bearer token

validation.rationale: All full Cloud report sections were reviewed. Baseline source at 2c59e073c8 contains the reported defect. The attack-path limitations are retained in the finding; suppression does not invalidate the control defect.

remediation.summary: Authenticate the owner SID of the connected pipe using the handle security descriptor before stdin is opened. Explicitly set the receiver owner, limit client impersonation, request ReadPermissions, and dispose on refusal. Native Windows ownership scenarios passed in job 123293604465. See research/qualification.md. Merged in PR #2333; exact Cloud identity observed Fixed on 2026-10-31.

remediation.summary: Consume malformed fragment candidates as disjoint spans instead of retrying the same suffix from each opener. Drop candidates without a fragment; retain valid IPv6 link syntax. Repeated opener and missing-fragment controls exercise the exported scanner. See research/qualification.md. Merged in PR #2333; exact Cloud identity observed Fixed on 2026-10-31.

remediation.summary: Settle walkers only before capture. After capture, refuse on the first observed walker and preserve the fenced directory. The process-table integration check injects a late write at the post-capture observation and verifies its survival. See research/qualification.md. Merged in PR #2333; exact Cloud identity observed Fixed on 2026-10-31.
